description: Generate a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ...) by merging JSON data into a Carbone template. Pass templateId for a stored template, or template (local path, HTTPS URL or base64) for a one-off render. To change the format of a file without data, use convert_document; unsure which data a template expects, call inspect_template first. Returns text and images (png, jpg, gif, webp) inline; other formats are saved to a temp file whose path is returned. Batches need a webhookUrl the user provides; otherwise render one document per call.

asAttachment.description: If true, return the file itself as a base64 attachment, for any format, instead of the default (temp file or inline).

batchOutput.description: Batch result: "zip" (default, named after reportName, or batch.zip without one) or "pdf", one concatenated PDF (needs convertTo "pdf").

batchReportName.description: Name of each file in the batch ZIP, without extension; tags resolve per item, e.g. "invoice-{d.id}".

batchSplitBy.description: One document per item of an array: "d" when data is the array, "d.items" for a child array; at most 100. Needs a webhookUrl the user provides.

complement.description: Extra data for {c.…} tags (company details, constants), or a reference to a JSON file.

formatName.description: Same values as the string form.

formatOptions.description: PDF: { "EncryptFile": true, "DocumentOpenPassword": "s3cr3t" }, { "Watermarks": [{ "text": "DRAFT", "opacity": 0.2 }] }, PDF/A { "SelectPdfVersion": 2 } or { "PageRange": "1-5" } (converter "L"). Images: { "PixelWidth": 1200, "Scale": 2, "Quality": 80 }. CSV: { "fieldSeparator": ";" }. All options: get_capabilities.

convertTo.description: Output format, e.g. "pdf". Omitted: the template's own format. Valid outputs depend on the input format (HTML converts to pdf or png, not xlsx; doc, xls and ppt are output only). With options: { "formatName": "pdf", "formatOptions": { ... } }.

converter.description: Converter, used whenever the format changes. "L" LibreOffice (default): every format, and the only one with PDF/A, page ranges and accessibility. "I" Carbone ICE: DOCX and ODT to PDF, the fastest (keep "L" for SmartArt, complex charts, comments, form fields, equations). "O" OnlyOffice: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF. "C" Chromium: HTML and SVG to PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP. Details: get_capabilities.

currencyRates.description: Rates per currency, base 1: { "EUR": 1, "USD": 1.08 }, or a reference to a JSON file.

currencySource.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts in data, for :formatC. Set with currencyTarget and currencyRates.

currencyTarget.description: ISO 4217 currency to convert the amounts to.

data.description: JSON for the {d.…} tags: an object, a top-level array, or a reference to a JSON file (local path, HTTPS URL or base64). Omitted: every tag renders empty; to keep tags as written, use keepTags. Tag syntax: the Carbone Skill.

egressAuthorization.description: Authorization header value Carbone sends when it fetches images, PDFs or the webhook while rendering.

enum.description: Labels for :convEnum(TYPE), e.g. { "STATUS": { "1": "Active" } }, or a reference to a JSON file.

failOn.description: ["IMAGE_URL_ERROR"]: fail when an image URL cannot be downloaded, instead of showing a placeholder.

hardRefresh.description: If true, recompute pagination and the table of contents after rendering. Needs convertTo.

keepTags.description: If true, skip templating: tags stay as written, to proof a template's layout. Exclusive with data.

outputPath.description: Local path to save the generated document to, e.g. "~/out.pdf"; returns the path and size. Never overwrites a file.

preReleaseFeatureIn.description: Turn on Carbone pre-release features up to this version tag, e.g. 5000000.

reportName.description: File name without extension; may use tags, e.g. "invoice-{d.id}" (taken literally with keepTags).

returnLink.description: If true, return a one-time download link instead of the file, for the user to open (never fetch it yourself). Exclusive with outputPath and asAttachment.

template.description: A one-off template, not stored. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). To reuse one, upload_template then pass templateId. Exclusive with templateId.

templateId.description: A stored template, from list_templates or upload_template (never guess one): its Template ID (digits, renders the deployed version) or a Version ID (64 hex characters, pins that version). Exclusive with template.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for :formatD dates, e.g. "America/New_York". Default "Europe/Paris".

translations.description: Strings for {t(key)}, selected by lang: { "fr-fr": { "hello": "Bonjour" } }, or a reference to a JSON file.

variableStr.description: Aliases for the whole template, e.g. "{#buyer = d.order.customer}", then {$buyer.name} in it.

webhookHeaders.description: Headers Carbone sends to webhookUrl, e.g. { "authorization": "secret" }.

webhookUrl.description: Only an endpoint the user owns and gives you: Carbone POSTs { "success": true, "data": { "renderId" } } to it when the document is ready, and that server downloads it once. This call then returns no document.

name: render_document
title: Generate Document
